added: The dance picker you use while building a program now has the Collection's Search in and Sort controls. It opens in your Collection sort order, and a sort you choose while picking lasts until you close the picker.
Online search in the dance picker can now search by author or figure as well as title, chosen with Search in, as in the Collection.
changed: Settings › Defaults › Collection card fields now also chooses what the program dance picker's rows show.
